sasha: Quick profiling help — I need a tiny coordinated capture across 4 GPUs for model_A (batch=8, seq=1024). Suspect a KV-cache prefetch regression after yesterday's runtime change. Can folks run a short nsys + torch profiler capture (30s steady) and upload scrubbed traces?

omar: I can run on rtx5 later today. What exact flags and scrub expectations?

sasha: Thanks — please do a warmup of ~20 iters, then capture ~30s. nsys command I used:
```
nsys profile -o /tmp/run2591234567 --trace=cuda,nvtx,osrt --sample=cpu --capture-range=kernel --force-overwrite 
  --sleep-before=2 --target-processes=all 
  --duration=30s 
```
And enable torch.profiler with:
```python
with torch.profiler.profile(activities=[ProfilerActivity.CPU, ProfilerActivity.CUDA],
  schedule=torch.profiler.schedule(wait=2,warmup=5,active=30),
  on_trace_ready=torch.profiler.tensorboard_trace_handler('/tmp/prof')):
  model.run(batch)
```
Please also generate a small flamegraph (torchprof -> speedscope or pprof output) if possible.

lee: For scrub rules: strip prompt texts, redact any customer IDs, remove hostnames/IPs from logs, and replace workspace paths with <REDACTED_PATH>. Add a run-id file in the tarball: run-id:2591234567 and a short note describing the capture commands.

maria: I'll create an upload bucket/dir and post back. @perf-bot can you provision a temp prefix?

perf-bot: Created prefix s3://redwood-perf/traces/mini-agg/2591234567. Please upload tar.gz and include a manifest.txt with run-id and scrub checklist.

omar: Upload done: s3://redwood-perf/traces/mini-agg/2591234567/rtx5-run.tar.gz (~120MB). Included: nsys.qdrep, torchprof.json, flamegraph.svg, manifest.txt. Manifest notes warmup=20, capture=30s, batch=8.

sasha: Got it, pulling now. I'll run a quick bisect and compare flamegraphs to yesterday's canary. If I see obvious KV-prefetch stalls I'll ping for a tiny repro. Please don't delete originals until I confirm.

lee: Quick heads-up — if you need a smaller sample set for faster upload next time, use --trace=nvtx,cuda only and disable system-wide sampling. That cut our last tarball by ~3x.

omar: noted. thanks! :thumbsup:

perf-bot: Reminder: please link perf-ticket #4312 in the manifest when you update the triage notes.

sasha: Will do. Tagging this as mini-agg/2591234567 — I'll post findings in ~2h. Appreciate the quick turn-around. :pray:
